#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int takeInt(istream& in) {
    int n; in >> n; return n;
}

vector<string> takeStrings(istream& in, int count) {
    vector<string> inp(count);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        in >> inp[i];
    }
    return inp;
}

vector<int> takeInts(istream& in, int count) {
    vector<int> arr(count);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        in >> arr[i];
    }
    return arr;
}

vector<char> generateStrings(const vector<char>& str, int n, char dig) {
    vector<char> strs(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (str[i] == 'X') strs[i] = dig;
        else strs[i] = str[i];
    }
    return strs;
}

long long cal(const vector<char>& str, const std::string& suffix, int n, int un) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    char last = suffix[1];
    char first = suffix[0];
    if (str[n - 1] == '_' || str[n - 1] == last) {
        if (str[n - 2] == '_' || str[n - 2] == first) {
            return (long long)pow(10, un);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

long long solve(const vector<char>& str, int n) {
    if (n == 1 || str[0] == '0') return 0;
    long long cnt = 0;
    int un = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i++) {
        if (str[i] == '_') ++un;
    }

    cnt += cal(str, "25", n, un);
    cnt += cal(str, "50", n, un);
    cnt += cal(str, "75", n, un);

    if (n > 2 && str[0] == '_') cnt *= 9;

    if (n >= 3) {
        if ((str[n - 1] == '_' || str[n - 1] == '0') && (str[n - 2] == '_' || str[n - 2] == '0')) {
            if (n > 3) {
                long long temp = (long long)pow(10, un);
                if (str[0] == '_') temp *= 9;
                cnt += temp;
            } else if (n == 3) {
                if (str[0] == '_') {
                    cnt += 9;
                } else {
                    cnt += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int test = 1;
    string line;
    ostringstream ans;
    while (test-- > 0) {
        getline(cin, line);
        vector<char> str(line.begin(), line.end());
        int n = (int)str.size();

        if (n == 1) {
            if (str[0] == '0' || str[0] == '_' || str[0] == 'X' || str[0] == '1') {
                ans << 1 << "\n";
                continue;
            }
        }

        long long cnt = 0;
        bool Xp = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (str[i] == 'X') Xp = true;
        }

        if (Xp) {
            for (char ch = '0'; ch <= '9'; ch++) {
                vector<char> genStr = generateStrings(str, n, ch);
                cnt += solve(genStr, n);
            }
        } else {
            cnt += solve(str, n);
        }
        ans << cnt << "\n";
    }
    cout << ans.str();
    return 0;
}
